t: You're looking at University College Hospital, a large teaching hospital in Bloomsbury, founded in 1834 as the North London Hospital. It is closely tied to University College London, whose main campus is next door. Several well-known figures died here. They include Alexander Litvinenko, the former Russian security officer and critic of Vladimir Putin, the actor Richard Harris, the novelist Beryl Bainbridge, and the theatre director Sir Peter Hall. The Pan-Africanist writer George Padmore and the Spanish painter Luis Ricardo Falero also died here.
